notes: NOT_IN_PACKET: per-arm event counts and follow-up/assessment window. Only diarrhoea percentages are printed; no event counts were inferred. Arm denominators describe participants who received each intervention, rather than explicitly stated randomised or analysed totals. August-October 2009 is the recruitment period. Mean diarrhoea durations of 4 and 5 days for Yakult and placebo, respectively, are a secondary outcome, not the assessment window.
